claims.text: ART is recommended for all patients with HIV.
claims.quote: treatment with antiretroviral therapy (ART) is now recommended for all patients
claims.locator: Antiretroviral Treatment of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) Infection

claims.text: Usual NRTI backbone: TAF or TDF plus emtricitabine or lamivudine, paired with an INSTI.
claims.quote: dolutegravir plus either tenofovir alafenamide or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate plus emtricitabine or lamivudine

claims.text: Emtricitabine 200 mg/TAF 25 mg: one tablet PO once daily, with or without food.
claims.quote: one tablet containing 200 mg FTC and 25 mg of TAF taken orally once daily with or without food
claims.locator: 2.3 Recommended Dosage for Treatment of HIV-1 Infection in Adults and Pediatric Patients

claims.text: Not recommended if CrCl 15 to <30 mL/min, or <15 mL/min without chronic hemodialysis.
claims.quote: DESCOVY is not recommended in individuals with estimated creatinine clearance of 15 to below 30 mL per minute, or below 15 mL per minute who are not receiving chronic hemodialysis.

claims.text: Abacavir: 600 mg/day PO (300 mg BID or 600 mg once daily) with other ARVs.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of ZIAGEN for adults is 600 mg daily, administered orally as either 300 mg twice daily or 600 mg once daily, in combination with other antiretroviral agents.

claims.text: Boxed warning: severe acute HBV flares can occur when emtricitabine/tenofovir is stopped.
claims.quote: Severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis B (HBV) have been reported in individuals with HBV who have discontinued products containing emtricitabine (FTC) and/or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) and may occur with discontinuation of DESCOVY.

claims.text: Test for HBV before or when starting.
claims.quote: Prior to or when initiating DESCOVY, test for hepatitis B virus infection.

claims.text: Before starting and during use: serum creatinine, CrCl, urine glucose and urine protein; add serum phosphorus in CKD.
claims.quote: Prior to or when initiating DESCOVY, and during use on a clinically appropriate schedule, assess serum creatinine, estimated creatinine clearance, urine glucose, and urine protein in all individuals. In individuals with chronic kidney disease, also assess serum phosphorus.

claims.text: Lactic acidosis and severe hepatomegaly with steatosis (including fatal cases) with nucleoside analogs;
claims.quote: Lactic acidosis and severe hepatomegaly with steatosis, including fatal cases, have been reported with the use of nucleoside analogs
Treatment with DESCOVY should be suspended in any individual who develops clinical or laboratory findings suggestive of lactic acidosis or pronounced hepatotoxicity

claims.text: Mitochondrial toxicity is highest with NRTIs.
TDF in a ritonavir-boosted regimen raises tenofovir levels and can cause renal dysfunction in susceptible patients.
claims.quote: Using tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) in a ritonavir-boosted regimen increases the plasma levels of tenofovir disoproxil and, in susceptible patients with certain comorbidities, causes renal dysfunction.

claims.text: Never restart abacavir after a hypersensitivity reaction, whatever the HLA-B*5701 status.
claims.quote: NEVER restart ZIAGEN or any other abacavir‑containing product following a hypersensitivity reaction to abacavir, regardless of HLA‑B*5701 status.
